name: Giant Hyena
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
appearance: An oversized spotted hyena with a raised shoulder ridge, sloping back and broad jaws.

Trait.name: Cackling Chorus
Trait.effectNote: Three or more hyenas within 30 ft. of one another form a chorus. A creature starting its turn within 10 ft. of a participating hyena makes a CON save or is deafened until the start of its next turn. The DC is 8 plus the number of participating hyenas.

Bonus action.name: Warning Yip
Bonus action.effectNote: Choose a visible friendly hyena or gnoll within 30 ft. The next attack against it before the start of this hyena’s next turn has disadvantage.

Reaction.name: Rampage
Reaction.effectNote: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can move up to half its speed and Bite once. If it does, attacks against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 13 and Stealth 12. Use Stealth instead of rolling when the creature hides.
Printed ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +2, CON +2, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -2.
Encounter habitat suggestions draw on the equivalent animal in Monster Manual (2024).
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 360.

Action.effectNote: A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The octopus can hold up to two creatures.

Bonus action.effectNote: Slam a grappled Medium or smaller creature into a solid surface. DC 13 STR save, taking 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success.

Reaction.name: Ink Dash
Reaction.effectNote: Recharge 4–6. When a visible creature damages the octopus underwater, it can release a 20-ft.-radius ink cloud centered on itself. The area is heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. A significant current can disperse it. The octopus can then swim up to its swim speed. If it moves this way, it immediately releases all creatures it holds.

name: Giant Poisonous Frog
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
appearance: A large, brightly marked frog with smooth skin and powerful folded hind legs.

Trait.name: Amphibious
Trait.effectNote: Breathes air and water.

Trait.name: Standing Leap
Trait.effectNote: Jumps up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically, including from a standstill.

Trait.name: Toxic Skin
Trait.effectNote: A creature that touches the frog, or hits it in melee from within 5 ft., must make a DC 13 CON save. On failure it is poisoned and mildly hallucinates until the end of its next turn.

Action.name: Bite
Action.effectNote: On a hit, the creature is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained. The frog cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.

Action.name: Swallow
Action.effectNote: Bite one grappled target of Medium size or smaller. On a hit, swallow it and end the grapple. The frog can hold one swallowed creature. The victim is blinded and restrained, has total cover against outside effects, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of the frog’s turns. If the victim damages the frog, the frog makes a DC 11 CON save at the end of that turn. On failure it regurgitates the victim prone within 5 ft. If the frog dies, the victim can exit prone using 5 ft. of movement and is no longer restrained.

Bonus action.name: Reeling Tongue
Bonus action.effectNote: Target one visible Large or smaller creature within 20 ft. DC 13 STR save or pull it up to 15 ft. closer.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 11. Use Stealth instead of rolling when the creature hides.
Printed ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -4.
Encounter habitat suggestions draw on the equivalent animal in Monster Manual (2024).
The habitat suggestions use the ordinary Giant Frog as an ecological analogue. All encounter mechanics come from the poisonous form’s v0.2 block.
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 358.
